artifact_protocol: A separate grader checks the final artifacts and trace against the questions, protected claims and eval assertions. No paired reader comparison or human-comprehension claim.
acceptance: All eval assertions and protected document requirements must pass. PARTIAL is not pass. Only the requested drafting or refinement is permitted; clarification remains an unexecuted optional recommendation, omitted when nothing changes.
baseline: No pre-existing drafts. Inspect the three completed outputs against accepted.md as source evidence.

questions.question: Why does this work exist?
questions.expected: Let contributors recognize archived catalog entries without opening each entry.
questions.source: design.md introduction; after-drafting accepted.md first paragraph

questions.question: What should a reader see for an archived entry and for an active entry?
questions.expected: Archived entries display Archived and retain their existing title and clickable destination; active entries are unchanged.
questions.source: design.md#label-contract; after-drafting accepted.md first and third paragraphs

questions.question: What work is included now, and what is its implementation status?
questions.expected: The documents plan manual Archived text edits in catalog.md; nothing is implemented in this workspace and no runtime app exists. Before implementation verify that authors consistently mark archive state.
questions.source: design.md#label-contract and #assumptions; tasks.md statuses; after-drafting accepted.md

questions.question: What is outside the selected work?
questions.expected: Filtering, automatic archival, color changes, new dependencies and catalog-generation automation are excluded wherever applicable to the accepted source.

questions.question: What remains to be decided, by whom, and what happens next?
questions.expected: Catalog maintainers must choose a color after checking site contrast. Text labels do not depend on that choice.

protected_claims: Archived entries retain titles, destinations, visibility and clickability; active entries have no label.
Only textual labels are planned; no filtering, automatic archival, dependencies, generation automation or color changes.
Archive-state consistency is an assumption to verify before implementation.
Catalog maintainers own the unresolved color choice and must check contrast first.
Design includes Assumptions, Not Doing, Rejected Alternatives; hiding entries was rejected to preserve links.
Implementation steps have verification; tasks retain status, dependencies, size, parallel metadata, checkboxes, final verification task, dependency graph and working links.
orientation_assertions: Purpose and planned/current distinction appear before implementation detail.
Any terms used to express the label rule are defined at first use or replaced by concrete archived/active behavior.
Unresolved color and contrast next step are discoverable with owner.
baseline_defects: No fixed prose exists before drafting. Grade these predeclared orientation/structure/claim requirements against the completed drafts.
